items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: Charlie Parker, he played music, it was not a gimmick.

ctx.x: like that. But I like to feel that there are certain areas where the one thing evolves into the other. I believe that swing was definitely evolved from jazz. No doubt about it. Even the Bop, you know, evolved out of swing because there are musicians that hear or feel something that is not being expressed at the time. They want to stretch out a little bit. Say, for instance I would say that the -- although Dizzy Gillespie is identified with the Bop era but that's a term, you know, but I think the greatest…
I think another name is Art Tatum, he was one of the giant soloists, as far as I know, never played with a band.
